budget_protocol: Each budget is a maximum GPU-second allowance per arm per paired trial, covering both fixed eight-replica blocks. Run all 12 pairs independently at each budget with fresh processes, no checkpoint reuse, adaptive stopping, extra steps or altered sampling. Budget caps do not define an outcome curve. Warmup is excluded from timed trials but its hardware consumption is reported separately. Report timeout as failure, no speedup or equivalence claim at that budget.

confidence_rule.decision: Executable v1 exact binomial order-statistic bounds only. Performance uses baseline GPU-seconds / method GPU-seconds for each of 12 timing pairs; one-sided 95% lower median bound must exceed 1.05 at every sealed budget. Equivalence alpha = 1-0.95 = 0.05. Bonferroni across both metrics and conservatively across all three methods and three budgets: 18 comparisons, two-sided alpha 0.05/18 each. Sort 16 seed differences; choose largest integer r >= 1 satisfying 2*sum(binomial(16,j), j=0..r-1)/2^16 <= 0.05/18 and use [difference_(r),difference_(17-r)]. This gives r=2 and finite bounds. Require every interval wholly inside its frozen positive absolute margins. Lack of significance never establishes equivalence. All scientific and completion checks must pass before claiming performance.

evidence_limits: Baseline contains one ensemble across eight seeds; no same-seed baseline repeats, full energy series, method outputs or paired-difference variance are available. Cross-seed variation does not establish same-seed repeatability.

Positive margins are explicit baseline-derived Monte Carlo uncertainty scales, not a published scientific requirement or calibrated long-time equilibrium accuracy claim. Median equivalence concerns only recorded mean and final energy summaries; it does not prove equality of trajectories or full distributions.

paired_seed_tests.description: Pair baseline and method by input identity, replica seed and seed block. Langevin integration and initial velocities use the identical replica seed in both arms. For each energy metric compute method minus baseline per seed, then exact two-sided order-statistic confidence bounds for the median paired difference. Require the entire confidence interval strictly inside [-abs_margin,+abs_margin]. Repeated timing runs are not independent scientific seeds; use the first scheduled completed pair at each method/budget for scientific differences. Missing seed, nonfinite output, changed step count, or failed trajectory invalidates the comparison.

sample_sizes.power_basis: Conditional prospective power calculation, not measured power: assume independent paired seed differences, centered at zero, normally distributed with standard deviation at most one quarter of the respective frozen margin. For 16 seeds, even min/max bounds fit inside the margin with probability (1-2*Phi(-4))^16, approximately 0.99899 per comparison. A union bound across 18 method/budget/metric comparisons gives joint power at least 0.9817 under this assumption. Actual paired variance unavailable; no unconditional power or empirical effect size claimed. No post hoc seed extension or margin widening.

scheduling_protocol: Use seed 731029 to randomize baseline-first versus method-first independently within each adjacent pair, and shuffle method/budget pair blocks before measurements. Run arms sequentially on the same reserved GPU; no cross-arm overlap. Keep fixed seed-block ordering in both arms and merge by replica seed. Record every attempted pair, order, timings and failure; no outlier removal or replacement.

splits.description: One fixed molecular input; no training split. Baseline seeds 1000..1007 calibrate frozen variability margins only. Evaluation seeds 2000..2015 have no measured outcomes in permitted evidence and are frozen before method code. No tuning on evaluation results; scope or tolerance changes require a new sealed run.

timing_scope.description: Time complete parent process plus all child workers from launch through final scientific output merge, worker teardown and process exit. Include imports, pinned input/force-field loading, system/context creation, CUDA initialization/compilation, initial velocities, integration, all energy queries, H2D/D2H transfers, synchronization, serialization and merge. Adapter synchronizes GPU completion before stopping timer. Measured baseline ensemble.json total_wall_s=58.55763009100002 excludes imports/input loading/serialization, so is contextual only and not silently substituted for this broader prospective scope. Each timing arm processes two sequential fixed eight-replica seed blocks; reserve GPU exclusively.

warmup_protocol: Zero warmup runs per arm. Fresh processes and contexts in every trial; preserve and record common on-disk cache state, alternate arms by sealed randomization, never exclude initialization costs after observing timings.
